title: Laboratory fortress_wait arguments
description: One existing tool supports ordinary duration-based waiting or one exact selected original plan or condition watch. Runtime admission checks current session ownership, grants, complete source bounds and response publication.

session_id.description: Optional wire selector resolved by the existing laboratory session resolver; supply the canonical owning session identifier returned by fortress_open_session.

max_game_ticks.description: Total time cap. Omitted/null means zero. Positive ticks require ControlClock. The world remains paused unless a separately authorized operation unpauses it.

plan_digest.description: One exact session-owned original committed plan; mutually exclusive with a non-null watch_id.

watch_id.description: One retained laboratory watch handle. Samples its immutable original condition at bounded published frontiers. Mutually exclusive with a non-null plan_digest.
